recipes.name: Eagle Brand Chocolate Fondue
ingredients_raw: 1 (14 ounce) can EAGLE BRAND® Sweetened Condensed Milk (NOT evaporated milk)

steps.text: Combine condensed milk, chocolate chips, butter, and water in a heavy saucepan over medium heat. Cook and stir until chocolate chips and butter melt, then continue to cook, stirring constantly until thickened, about 5 more minutes. Remove from the heat and stir in vanilla.

raw_recipe.headline: Eagle Brand Chocolate Fondue
raw_recipe.description: Make this chocolate fondue for elegant dinner parties as well as after-school snacks. Serve with fruits, cookies, marshmallows, or cake cubes.

review.reviewBody: I'm pretty picky about chocolate fondue because it seems like most of them have such an intense flavor that it covers the flavor of the fruit you dip in it. This one, however, complimented the flavor of the fruit PERFECTLY and had a great chocolate flavor on it's own, too. I thought the consistency was perfect. We dipped pound cake, bananas, marshmallows, strawberries, clementine oranges, cinnamon graham crackers and pineapple in it (my favorites were the strawberries and pineapple). I will definitely make it again, it was so much fun, so easy and so good!

This was SO easy & delicious! Made chocolate fondue for my daughters 6th birthday.
I used a Cuisinart electric, non-stick fondue set , so I only had to clean one pan & it was really easy.
I followed the recipe *almost* exactly, except we used a full 12oz bag of milk chocolate chips instead of semi sweet. Also followed another recommendation I read: I cut up a pineapple as one of the things to dip, but one cut, I let it sit in a strainer for 30 minutes to get rid of the extra juice.
Other items we dipped were, pretzels, potato chips, twix bars, and of course apples & strawberries. This was so easy & kids & adults both liked it. Will do it again for sure!

I never take time to write reviews, but I HAD to for this recipe. I tripled the recipe for my 50 person office and everyone absolutely loved it. I actually made the recipe in my crock pot. I left it on high while the chocolate chips melted and continually stirred, and once they were melted turned it on warm so everyone could enjoy. Maybe the best chocolate I've ever had. A must make for any party!

Toppings: Bananas, Strawberries, Store bought angel food cake, graham crackers, and marshmallows.

This is a perfect fondue, and so easy to make. I threw all the ingredients in a mini crock pot and just stirred once in a while until it was ready. Make sure to unplug it before things overcook, though! I added a little heavy cream when it got a little thick and that brought it back to a dipping consistency. The taste is great! We'll probably use the leftovers as a hot fudge topping for ice cream.

Super yummy! I made this in my Little Dipper CrockPot, stirring every 15 minutes, for a little over an hour while I was doing party prep in the kitchen. I omitted the vanilla, simply because the kids were already eating it before I added it in. Once cooked, be sure to take the lid off to prevent the addition of extra water. The crockpot holds its temp for quite awhile, so I just wound the cord up with a twist tie and put the crockpot directly on the table. Served it with apples, bananas, cookies, Rice Krispies treat cut into fourths, mini marshmallows, pretzels, graham crackers, 2 kinds of wafer cookies, and 2 other types of cookies. So easy! Definitely a keeper!

I converted this to vegan by subbing sweetened condensed coconut milk and Miyoko's vegan butter. Many semi sweet chocolate chip brands are vegan. It was delicious, just as good as the dairy version, no coconut taste. Incredibly easy. Served with strawberries, pineapple, marshmallows, and homemade vegan pound cake. Huge success!
Super easy to make vegan as well! Switched out and used vegan semi-sweet chocolate chips, coconut milk based sweetened condensed milk, and just 1 T of plant-based butter. My husband and I loved it!!

While this was delicious, it was entirely too thick (think the consistency of cold pudding even while hot)! I substituted milk for the water because I was honestly afraid of seizing up my chocolate, but next time I’d add even more to thin it out! Don’t forget the vanilla, it adds a whole other depth of flavor!

great base recipe. I will change up the extract depending on the event. Rum extract is really nice. I also use it as a base for smores dip. Put in the bottom of a medium baker with marshmallows on top. Broil till just brown and use graham wafers to dip. Really easy decadent mix and freezes well too.

So simple and so delicious. Don't over think this one. I accidently bought chocolate mint mini chips. But 25 teens were on their way for a progressive dinner so we wnt with it. Dumped in 2 bags of chips (is a bag a cup??? Oh well!) And doubled all the other ingredients. Finished with a little extra water to get a good dipping consistency. It wasn't the only thing I served but it was completely gone in 40 minutes. True winner!

Excellent recipe that melts to perfection and has great flavor. I added about a 1/4 cup of dark chocolate to the semi sweet for added richness, and melted everything in a fondue pot. We dipped in pretzels, bananas, strawberries, marshmallows, graham crackers and a few potato chips for fun. Crushed peppermint was a fun garnish as well. Enjoy!
Sweet but a kid pleaser….i have made more complicated recipes that fell flat…so this is an easy winner.
Easy and yummy!! Made this several times. Definitely a keeper.
Love it. Out all ingredients but vanilla, in a small slow cooker for one hour, then added vanilla. Kept it on warm while in use! The other day
Easy and delicious. I prepared it exactly per the recipe.
My kids love this! We make it for New Year's Eve, then have the leftovers the next morning on crepes with strawberries.
Y.U.M.M.Y! This is the second year we've used this recipe for our annual New Years Eve fondue dinner. Comes out great each time!
I decreased the chocolate slightly and added some bittersweet chocolate and it turned out perfectly sweet. Super easy and everyone loved it.
Perfect!! We love this chocolate fondue.
Easy to make and so delicious with bananas and berries, I received many compliments on this dessert.
